name: harness-lite
goal: Verify SvelteKit and Godot logic in a browser-free 1 GB and 0.5 vCPU run, then add visual proof for the same commit in full mode.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Exact-commit full remains the default. Lite runs the non-browser checks on the same declared states, records deferred browser checks and visual captures, and cannot prove the full gate. Prove unchanged-commit upgrade plus peak memory, CPU and time in cgroups.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Browser-free exact-commit Lite, headless Godot, deferred coverage and independent one-page capture implemented. Both constrained fixtures passed and were upgraded to full screenshots on MB2. The captured single page renders in ARM64 Chromium Headless Shell.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: At 71e223d767, 168 focused tests and five verification E2Es passed. Source ownership reviews and typechecking passed. Both real fixtures passed under the capped worker and gained exact-commit full screenshots.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
